nodes.name: 未配信の開発通知を取得

parameters.query:
SELECT
  o.id,o.event_type,o.project_key,COALESCE(o.task_code,'') task_code,
  COALESCE(CAST(u.id AS CHAR),JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(o.payload_json,'$.taskNumber')),'') task_number,
  COALESCE(u.title,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(o.payload_json,'$.taskTitle')),'') task_title,
  COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(o.payload_json,'$.reason')),'') reason,
  COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(o.payload_json,'$.commit')),'') commit_hash,
  COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(o.payload_json,'$.message')),'') payload_message,
  COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(o.payload_json,'$.recommendedAction')),JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(o.payload_json,'$.recommended_action')),'') recommended_action,
  COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(o.payload_json,'$.approvalAction')),JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(o.payload_json,'$.operation')),'') approval_action,
  COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(o.payload_json,'$.impact')),'') impact
FROM task_dispatcher_outbox o
LEFT JOIN user_tasks u ON u.owner_key='kuhara_hisashi' AND BINARY u.task_code=BINARY o.task_code
WHERE o.delivered_at IS NULL AND o.id>=69
ORDER BY o.id ASC LIMIT 50;
